title: Berezin Ranges of Composition Operators on $H^2$
summary: We explore properties of the Berezin range $B(C_φ)$ of a composition operator $C_φ$ on the Hardy space $H^2$, including constraints on its location in the complex plane $\mathbb{C}$, topological properties, shape, symmetry, and convexity. For example, we show that $B(C_φ) \subseteq \{z\in \mathbb{C}: \Re(z) > 0 \ \text{and}\ |z| \le 1 + |φ(0)|\}$, that $B(C_φ)$ is closed if and only if $C_φ$ is the identity operator, and that $B(C_φ)$ containa all its boundary points except for $0$ if $C_φ$ is compact.
